name: 4×4 keypad
description: Membrane keypad with 16 keys in 4 rows (R1–R4) and 4 columns (C1–C4). Pressing a key connects its row pin to its column pin, so a sketch finds the key by pulling one row LOW at a time and reading the columns with INPUT_PULLUP (or the other way round). Click keys while the simulation runs, type them on your keyboard after clicking the keypad, or Ctrl/Cmd+click to hold several keys down.
